result.notes: Official OAuth2-only REST API (Authorization Code + Client Credentials flows) at api.helpscout.net/v2, covering conversations, customers, inboxes, organizations, reports, users, teams, webhooks, workflows, tags, ratings (medium breadth). API access requires a paid Standard/Plus/Pro subscription, but Help Scout offers a 15-day no-credit-card free trial on Standard/Plus during which a developer can create an OAuth2 app and get working credentials — hence self_serve_trial rather than paid_plan. No official MCP server; several community/third-party MCP servers exist on GitHub (most-starred: drewburchfield/help-scout-mcp-server, 47★), explicitly not affiliated with Help Scout. Composio also wraps the API via OAuth2 (129 tools), consistent with rest/medium breadth.
result.one_liner: Help Scout is a customer support helpdesk platform (shared inbox, live chat, knowledge base, and Docs) for small-to-mid-size support teams.
